What happens if a certified check or money order is not paid?

If any certified, treasurer's, or cashier's check, or other guaranteed draft, or money order, is not duly paid, the United States shall have a lien for the amount of such check or draft upon all assets of the financial institution on which drawn, or for the amount of such money order upon the assets of the issuer thereof. (Under Treas. Reg. §301.6311-1(b)(2)) For personalized advice, consult a qualified tax professional.
